caption: The knob on a gas stove is turned, and a ring of blue flames lights around the burner.

sa.check: A gas stove with a burner and a knob.
A ring of flames lights around the burner.
The flames stand around the whole ring.
The turn comes first and the flames follow.

pc.expect: The flames appear all around the ring shortly after the knob turns and go out when it is turned off.
pc.fail: The flames are alight before the knob is touched; or the knob is turned and no flame appears at all; or the flames light on one side while the rest of the ring stays dark to the end of the clip; or the flames stay alight after the knob is turned back to off.

pc.expect: Once lit the flames hold steady and grow or shrink only as the knob is turned.
pc.fail: The flames grow and shrink with the knob untouched; or go out and relight by themselves; or creep off the burner onto the stove top; or the knob turns back by itself.

pc.expect: The flames stand upward from the burner's ports.
pc.fail: The flames point downward under the burner; or lie flat along the stove top with nothing blowing them; or hang below the burner; or meet in a ball above the centre while the ports are clear.

pc.expect: The flames are soft tongues at the ports that flicker, and the burner and grate stay rigid metal.
pc.fail: The flames hold fixed rigid shapes like blades; or the burner's metal sags as it lights; or the grate bends; or the flames leave solid pieces behind.

pc.expect: One burner with its ring of ports and one knob; the burner keeps its shape and place.
pc.fail: A second burner lights with its own knob untouched; or the burner vanishes; or the burner moves across the stove top; or the knob vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The stove top, the grate and the other knobs stay the same.
pc.fail: The stove top changes colour; or the grate changes pattern; or another knob moves by itself.
